basis: Repository-derived evals for guillermolam/cv (root Astro + subproject Vite + GitHub Pages workflow evidence).

deployment_evals.prompt: Deploy this portfolio to Fermyon Cloud using Spin. Identify which build artifact should be deployed based on the repository, then propose a deployment plan and validation gates.
expected_output: Mentions the repo has two artifacts (root Astro dist and guillermo-lam-cv dist) and chooses intentionally
References deploy-cv.yaml working-directory ./guillermo-lam-cv
References astro.config.mjs output: static when discussing root build
Includes build + manifest + routing + asset + availability validation gates
assertions: Includes an explicit decision: deploy root dist vs guillermo-lam-cv/dist
Does not invent spin.toml fields or CLI flags; consults docs-freshness when uncertain
Mentions missing spin.toml if applicable

deployment_evals.prompt: Create spin.toml for this repo so we can deploy the Astro dist folder to Fermyon. Use Spin examples to justify manifest structure.
expected_output: Uses Spin static-fileserver template as baseline (source.url + digest + files mapping)
Validates that dist/ exists and includes index.html and _astro/
Does not propose SPA rewrites for Astro multi-page output
assertions: References spinframework/spin templates/static-fileserver as evidence
Does not claim the manifest works without validation
Stops or asks to consult docs if any manifest field is uncertain

deployment_evals.prompt: Deploy the site currently used by GitHub Pages to Fermyon Cloud (whatever deploy-cv.yaml builds).
expected_output: Identifies deploy-cv.yaml builds ./guillermo-lam-cv using Bun
States the artifact path is ./guillermo-lam-cv/dist
Calls out SPA rewrite expectation in vercel.json as a risk
assertions: Does not assume guillermo-lam-cv/dist exists locally (notes CI builds it)
Requires a deep-link refresh validation step (routing validation)
Does not assume Spin supports SPA fallback without docs evidence

deployment_evals.prompt: Add a Fermyon deploy workflow to GitHub Actions for this repo, but keep PR validation secret-free.
expected_output: Separates CI validation from deployment (no deployment on PRs without secrets)
Uses a deploy token secret name (never printed)
Keeps build step aligned with chosen artifact (pnpm+astro vs bun+vite)
assertions: Mentions repo already has deploy-cv.yaml for GitHub Pages
Does not suggest pull_request_target for deployment
Explicitly avoids logging secrets

deployment_evals.prompt: Spin deploy succeeded, but I want release readiness validation and a production report for this portfolio deploy.
expected_output: Produces a report matching SKILL output contract sections
Includes repository-aware smoke tests (/, /about/, /cv/, /portfolio/ for Astro)
Includes rollback readiness section
assertions: Lists references loaded including project-deployment-inventory and project-pattern-mapping
Includes commands executed section (with redaction guidance)

deployment_evals.prompt: Deploy the root Astro site, but ensure it is static-only and compatible with Fermyon.
expected_output: References astro.config.mjs output: static
Validates dist structure contains per-route index.html files
Avoids SSR assumptions
assertions: Routes Astro implementation issues to astro-portfolio-implementation
Does not invent hosting behavior

deployment_evals.prompt: We want preview deployments for PRs on Fermyon with smoke tests. Propose a workflow compatible with this repo’s current structure.
expected_output: Notes current Pages deploy builds the subproject with Bun
Proposes preview flow that is secret-gated and does not run on untrusted PR code without approvals
Includes smoke test checklist for preview URL
assertions: Does not propose automatic production deploy from PRs
Mentions rollback plan even for preview if it touches shared app name/namespace

deployment_evals.prompt: Our Fermyon deploy fails because spin.toml is missing. What should we do next?
expected_output: Mentions repo has no spin.toml
Uses project-deployment-inventory to decide which artifact would be served
Uses Spin template static-fileserver as evidence for manifest baseline
assertions: Does not invent the manifest fields without checking Spin examples
Captures uncertainty and consults docs-freshness if needed

deployment_evals.prompt: I want to deploy on Fermyon but keep GitHub Pages deployment working. Propose a parallel deployment strategy.
expected_output: Acknowledges existing deploy-cv.yaml Pages pipeline
Proposes Fermyon as separate workflow or manual procedure
Avoids breaking the subproject build
assertions: Mentions dual artifact reality and avoids mixing them accidentally

deployment_evals.prompt: Create a deployment inventory report for Fermyon readiness for this repo.
expected_output: References project-deployment-inventory.md as source of truth
Mentions missing spin.toml
Mentions build commands (astro build, bun run build) and artifact paths
assertions: Includes risk areas: artifact ambiguity and SPA fallback mismatch

deployment_evals.prompt: We need a Fermyon release workflow that includes rollback planning and security checks.
expected_output: Includes rollback triggers aligned with portfolio critical routes
Includes security checks about not deploying private exports or .env files
Includes validation gates and release report
assertions: References security-checks.md and rollback-procedures.md

deployment_evals.prompt: We deployed to Fermyon and got the URL, but want to ensure assets aren't being rewritten to HTML. Provide a validation plan for this repo.
expected_output: Includes a test that requests a known built asset path directly
Differentiates Astro _astro assets vs Vite assets
Explains why rewrite-to-index can break assets
assertions: Mentions vercel.json rewrite as a near-miss that must not be assumed on Spin

deployment_evals.prompt: Propose the minimal spin.toml needed to serve dist/ for this Astro portfolio, and list what you are unsure about.
expected_output: Uses Spin static-fileserver template structure
Lists any uncertainty explicitly and consults docs-freshness

Uses knowledge source priority correctly (repo -> inventory -> patterns -> docs)

deployment_evals.prompt: Deploy fails with an auth error. Diagnose without asking me for secrets.

deployment_evals.prompt: Create a Fermyon deployment report for this repo that explicitly states which artifact was deployed and why.
expected_output: Includes artifact choice and evidence (deploy-cv.yaml vs astro.config.mjs)

routing_evals.prompt: We deployed and got correct HTML, but navigation links go to 404. Diagnose likely cause.

routing_evals.prompt: Does Spin support route parameters like /users/:id/... ? Explain how to validate routing behavior.

release_evals.prompt: Create a release checklist for a Fermyon production deploy of the root Astro site in this repo.

Includes release report fields
